subject: SORT statement
notes: kb/Work PB995. cite.py --check 14.9.40.3 'the file description entry for file-name-2 shall describe neither records smaller than the smallest record nor larger than the largest record described for file-name-1' -> OK §14.9.40.3 5). SortBinder.ScreenTransferRecordSizes compares FileModel.RecordSizeRange of the USING file with the SD's: a variable-length SD bounds both ends, a fixed-length SD only the upper one (COBOL1757, citing SR5). Probes on the w1012h build: SD fixed 5 with a USING file of 8; SD VARYING 3 TO 5 with a USING file of 2 and of 9 are each refused; equal and smaller sizes compile and run (85/pb995_sort_merge_record_size_ranges). GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 accepts every one of the refused shapes (rule 1: the ISO text controls).
